chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

Whoever accompanies the funeral of a believer until he is buried in his grave, Allah will appoint for him seventy angels from among those accompanying, who will accompany him and seek forgiveness for him when he comes out of his grave to the standing place.

key_terms.الْمَوْقِفِ: the place of standing on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.جَنَازَةَ: the funeral bier or funeral of the deceased
key_terms.شَيَّعَ: accompanied and followed in a funeral procession

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for accompanying the funeral of a believer until burial?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the great merit of accompanying the funeral of a believer until burial. It promises a profound afterlife reward: seventy angels will accompany that person and seek forgiveness for him from his emergence from the grave until the standing place on the Day of Judgment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Whoever accompanies the funeral of a believer until they are buried in their grave, Allah (swt) will assign seventy angels to accompany and seek forgiveness for that person when they rise from their grave to stand at the gathering (on the Day of Judgment)."
